sources.note: Product identity and supplier/consumer semantics; local 3.12 product_information records supply chemical identities and stated compositions.
Allocated cutoff inventory interpretation; intermediate flows are not an unallocated physical material balance.
Battery-grade lithium hydroxide represents LiOH.H2O; ordinary lithium hydroxide represents anhydrous LiOH.
Cobalt sulfate inventory explicitly uses 0.38 kg Co per kg CoSO4.
Kelly et al. 2021 distinguishes carbonate and hydroxide monohydrate.
CAS 1333-82-0 confirms CrO3; the local product paragraph incorrectly describes Cr2O3.

Lu2O3 identity for the refined oxide product.
Nominal Pr6O11 convention for unspecified commercial praseodymium oxide.

coverage_limits: Selected compounds are an explicit subset, not all chemicals containing each element. See each product list and the unselected-product inventory.
Mixed rare-earth oxides (La-Ce, Pr-Nd, Sm-Eu-Gd and Tb-Dy) lack verified elemental splits. Their direct use is outside the quantified subset; selected separated oxides downstream are counted.
Generic alloys are measured separately in product mass; embedded elemental metal is not inferred.
Components, ores, concentrates, scraps and wastes are outside the selected commodity boundary.
Absence from the selected products is a coverage limitation, not proof of zero material use.
